reviews.body:
## Pull request overview

This PR continues the “thin command handler” direction by moving session teardown orchestration out of Tauri command handlers and relying on domain/service-layer validation for browser session creation.

**Changes:**
- Added `SessionCleanupService::remove_session_complete()` to orchestrate auxiliary cleanup + workspace removal.
- Simplified `remove_session` Tauri command to delegate to the service method.
- Removed redundant empty-URL validation from the `create_browser_session` command (validation already exists in `InteractiveBrowserServer`).

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `src-tauri/src/services/session_cleanup_service.rs` | Adds a new “complete removal” orchestration method for session teardown. |
| `src-tauri/src/commands/session_commands.rs` | Replaces inline teardown steps with a single service call. |
| `src-tauri/src/commands/browser_commands.rs` | Removes command-layer URL empty-check, delegating to `InteractiveBrowserServer`. |
| `.jules/nexus.md` | Logs the architectural change under the Nexus protocol. |
